description: She wears an opaque deep rust-burgundy floor-length gown with a square neckline, fitted bodice, elbow-length sleeves and a broad full skirt. Narrow cream-and-tan geometric borders frame the neckline, cuffs and a vertical front inset. A cream wrap edged with burgundy geometric bands lies across both forearms and hangs down each side. A brown leather belt closes with a round gold-toned clasp; its long hanging strap ends in a gold-toned ornament. Brown leather shoe toes appear beneath the skirt. No headgear or weapon is visible.
